known_issues: The echoed frame is compared field for field across all sixteen FrameWire fields. This is fail-closed and correct against the current Runtime, whose Frame is a frozen dataclass with no normalization on the wire round trip; if the Runtime ever normalizes a field on the echo path (a rescaled timestamp, a re-encoded payload), this client would refuse a legitimate response. Recorded as a contract coupling to revisit if that changes.
The 1000-frame bound is mirrored from the Runtime's MAX_BATCH_FRAMES and asserted through a stubbed fetch; it has not been exercised against a live Runtime process.
deferred_items: A decode-batch integration run against a real Runtime process (including the 1000-frame boundary and a real per-frame failure code) belongs to V0.3-FINAL or a later task; it is NOT VERIFIED here.
